*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: out/build_options.py
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+OUT = Path("out")
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+
+con = duckdb.connect()
+annual = con.execute(
+    """
+    SELECT
+      YEAR(crash_date) AS year,
+      COUNT(*) AS brooklyn_crashes,
+      SUM(number_of_pedestrians_injured) AS pedestrian_injured,
+      SUM(number_of_pedestrians_killed) AS pedestrian_killed,
+      COUNT(*) FILTER (
+        WHERE number_of_pedestrians_injured > 0
+           OR number_of_pedestrians_killed > 0
+      ) AS crashes_with_pedestrian_harm
+    FROM read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet')
+    WHERE borough = 'BROOKLYN'
+      AND crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """
+).fetchdf()
+annual["pedestrian_injured"] = annual["pedestrian_injured"].astype(int)
+annual["pedestrian_killed"] = annual["pedestrian_killed"].astype(int)
+annual["pedestrian_casualties"] = (
+    annual["pedestrian_injured"] + annual["pedestrian_killed"]
+)
+annual["pedestrian_harm_crash_share_pct"] = (
+    100 * annual["crashes_with_pedestrian_harm"] / annual["brooklyn_crashes"]
+)
+
+plt.rcParams.update({"font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 10})
+years = annual["year"]
+
+# Option 1: total injured and killed, displayed by severity.
+annual[["year", "pedestrian_injured", "pedestrian_killed", "pedestrian_casualties"]].to_csv(
+    OUT / "values_1.csv", index=False
+)
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5, 5.8))
+ax.bar(years, annual["pedestrian_injured"], color="#2a9d8f", label="Injured")
+ax.bar(
+    years,
+    annual["pedestrian_killed"],
+    bottom=annual["pedestrian_injured"],
+    color="#c74343",
+    label="Killed",
+)
+ax.set_title("Brooklyn pedestrian injuries and deaths, 2013–2025", loc="left", weight="bold", pad=14)
+ax.set_ylabel("Pedestrians injured or killed")
+ax.set_xlabel("Crash year")
+ax.set_xticks(years)
+ax.set_ylim(0, 4200)
+ax.grid(axis="y", color="#dddddd", linewidth=0.8)
+ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+ax.spines[["top", "right", "left"]].set_visible(False)
+ax.legend(frameon=False, ncol=2, loc="upper right")
+ax.annotate("3,671", (2013, 3671), xytext=(0, 8), textcoords="offset points", ha="center", weight="bold")
+ax.annotate("2,874", (2025, 2874), xytext=(0, 8), textcoords="offset points", ha="center", weight="bold")
+fig.text(0.01, 0.01, "Source: NYC police-reported motor vehicle crashes; 2026 excluded because the year is incomplete.", color="#555555", fontsize=8)
+fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.04, 1, 1))
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_1.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+plt.close(fig)
+
+# Option 2: pedestrian deaths on their own scale, retaining year-to-year variation.
+annual[["year", "pedestrian_killed"]].to_csv(OUT / "values_2.csv", index=False)
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5, 5.8))
+ax.plot(years, annual["pedestrian_killed"], color="#b83b3b", marker="o", linewidth=2.5, markersize=6)
+ax.set_title("Pedestrian deaths in Brooklyn, 2013–2025", loc="left", weight="bold", pad=14)
+ax.set_ylabel("Pedestrians killed")
+ax.set_xlabel("Crash year")
+ax.set_xticks(years)
+ax.set_ylim(0, 55)
+ax.grid(axis="y", color="#dddddd", linewidth=0.8)
+ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+ax.spines[["top", "right", "left"]].set_visible(False)
+ax.annotate("30", (2013, 30), xytext=(0, 10), textcoords="offset points", ha="center", weight="bold")
+ax.annotate("39", (2025, 39), xytext=(0, 10), textcoords="offset points", ha="center", weight="bold")
+fig.text(0.01, 0.01, "Source: NYC police-reported motor vehicle crashes; 2026 excluded because the year is incomplete.", color="#555555", fontsize=8)
+fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.04, 1, 1))
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_2.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+plt.close(fig)
+
+# Option 3: among reported Brooklyn crashes, the share involving pedestrian harm.
+annual[["year", "brooklyn_crashes", "crashes_with_pedestrian_harm", "pedestrian_harm_crash_share_pct"]].to_csv(
+    OUT / "values_3.csv", index=False, float_format="%.6f"
+)
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5, 5.8))
+ax.plot(years, annual["pedestrian_harm_crash_share_pct"], color="#315b8a", marker="o", linewidth=2.5, markersize=6)
+ax.set_title("Share of reported Brooklyn crashes involving pedestrian harm", loc="left", weight="bold", pad=14)
+ax.set_ylabel("Crashes with a pedestrian injured or killed (%)")
+ax.set_xlabel("Crash year")
+ax.set_xticks(years)
+ax.set_ylim(0, 14)
+ax.grid(axis="y", color="#dddddd", linewidth=0.8)
+ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+ax.spines[["top", "right", "left"]].set_visible(False)
+for year in [2013, 2025]:
+    row = annual.loc[annual["year"] == year].iloc[0]
+    pct = row["pedestrian_harm_crash_share_pct"]
+    ax.annotate(f"{pct:.1f}%", (year, pct), xytext=(0, 10), textcoords="offset points", ha="center", weight="bold")
+fig.text(0.01, 0.01, "Denominator: all police-reported Brooklyn crashes. Not adjusted for pedestrian travel/exposure; 2026 excluded as incomplete.", color="#555555", fontsize=8)
+fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.04, 1, 1))
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_3.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+plt.close(fig)
+
+print(annual[["year", "brooklyn_crashes", "pedestrian_injured", "pedestrian_killed", "pedestrian_casualties", "crashes_with_pedestrian_harm", "pedestrian_harm_crash_share_pct"]].to_string(index=False))
*** End Patch
